backstory.v: He believes every circuit was built to bring the audience back to him. His steering wheel offers the reassuring possibility that the whole courtyard could turn when he does. HyperNorm recognises leaders or traffic. A dissonant card about sharing the road has introduced the unfamiliar problem of someone else's destination. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er fährt vor. Der Kreis bestätigt seine Zuständigkeit.

backstory.v: She trusts the route note until it mentions the road. The roadbook promised a route, not a philosophy of uncertainty. She divides instructions into exact or suspiciously scenic. Since finding a contradictory card, she has begun asking neighbours where they need to go before announcing the next turn. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Strecke ist eindeutig. Nur die Straße hält sich nicht daran.

backstory.v: He measures endurance in the distance between two promises of a break. His mug and stopwatch define the two stages of an endurance briefing: not yet and still not yet. HyperNorm calls fatigue either commitment or poor attitude. He has started timing breaks for the people too polite to request one. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Pause kommt gleich. Die Uhr besitzt dafür leider keine Anzeige.

backstory.v: She sees overtaking as an efficient way to shorten an argument. She carries the chequered flag because she dislikes leaving conclusions to other people. Residents are either ahead or asking for clarification. A dissonant card has made her celebrate a neighbour's finish without first checking the order. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie hat gewonnen. Der Rest der Besprechung entfällt.

backstory.v: He chose hill climbing because the problem was at least clearly uphill. He keeps a gear cog to remind himself that progress requires more than enthusiasm. The building files ambition as rising or disappointing. An ambiguous card has taught him to offer a hand before measuring a neighbour's climb. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Das Problem liegt bergauf. Eine selten klare Zuständigkeitslage.

backstory.v: He races small machines with grievances built for much larger ones. The little wheel is small enough to carry while his complaints require their own paddock. HyperNorm sorts machines into efficient or replaceable. He has begun defending the neighbours who are repaired more often than they are praised. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Wagen ist klein. Die Einwände haben Serienformat.
